title: Cao Bang in two days
summary: Night one for the falls, night two for a different road. The second day is Phia Oac, a full day west, or Pac Bo, a half day north. Do not put the falls on both.

days.title: Ban Gioc, the cave, and the pagoda
days.body: Sleep in Dam Thuy, or leave Cao Bang city early. Be at the falls inside 10:30 to 15:30 when the water is low. Nguom Ngao is about an hour for the lit walk, about 4 km away. Truc Lam Ban Gioc is the short steep viewpoint on the same valley. Fees are check on arrival.

days.title: Phia Oac or Pac Bo
days.body: Choose one. Phia Oac is a full day west, moss forest up to a 1,935 m summit. Pac Bo is a half day north, about 55 km on provincial road 203, for Coc Bo and the stream. Drive minutes and gate fees are check on arrival. Ha Giang is a further overnight, not this day.

seoDescription: Two days in Cao Bang: Ban Gioc with the cave and the pagoda, then Phia Oac or Pac Bo. The roads leave town in different directions.
